faq.title: Quick answers for travelers
faq.fallback: Didn't find what you needed? Write to us and we'll get back to you directly.

q1.question: How do I book a tour or vehicle?
q1.answer: Search by destination and dates from the homepage, pick your experience and book in minutes. You'll get instant confirmation.

q2.question: Are payments secure?
q2.answer: Yes. All payments are processed with end-to-end encryption and we accept card, Google Pay and Bitcoin.

q3.question: Can I cancel or change my booking?
q3.answer: Each tour or rental has its own cancellation policy, visible before booking and in your confirmation.

q4.question: Are hosts verified?
q4.answer: Yes, every tour and vehicle goes through an approval process before being published on Dubuu.

q5.question: When will properties be available?
q5.answer: We're preparing the launch of exclusive properties. Leave your email to be the first to know.

q6.question: What languages can I book in?
q6.answer: Dubuu is available in Spanish and English, and many of our hosts speak both.
